nuggets.text: Billy Napier earned his first win as the Dukes' head coach in a 20-13 season opener over Liberty.
The Dukes scored on each of their first four possessions against Liberty, alternating touchdowns and field goals.
The Dukes went 12-1 last season and became the first Sun Belt team ever to reach the College Football Playoff.
The Dukes stunned 13th-ranked Virginia Tech 21-16 in Blacksburg in 2010, back in their FCS days.
Saturday's game is the first-ever football meeting between the Dukes and Wagner.
The Dukes nickname dates to 1947, when basketball players chose it to honor school president Samuel P. Duke.
Duke Dog is an English bulldog because that was seen as the stereotypical pet of British royalty, like a duke.
The Dukes won FCS national championships in 2004 and 2016.
Billy Napier went 40-12 at Louisiana from 2018-21, reaching the Sun Belt title game four times.
The Dukes held Liberty to 91 rushing yards on 38 carries, just 2.4 yards per try, in the opener.
